core.title: Butterfly Smooth Iron Cabinet Hinge Pair, Acorn AJ1BQ

text.description_html:
Acorn AJ1BQ, Decorative Smooth Iron Butterfly Hinges

For interior cabinet doors, Acorn's Butterfly Hinges are attractive full surface hinges with unusual but authentic designs. No mortising necessary. Easy to install, they come packaged with black screws. Great for old style decor from colonial times or ranch style homes. The smooth iron finish is typical of early American styling, with a flat black appearance which simulates the hardware as it may have looked originally if it was forged a century ago.

Features of the Acorn AJ1BQ Butterfly Hinges:

  • Finish: Smooth Black Iron
  • Length: 2-3/4"
  • Width: 2"

Priced and sold as a pair (2-hinges).
